items.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: He was in the group as a permanent member at that time.

ctx.x: Well the chair has certain solos that are built into it. You know, like if you come in the band and this particular tune had the solo for your chair then you played it. Somebody would tell you, hey man, this is your chorus. So that’s all there was to that.
Was Joe Williams still performing occasionally with the group at that time?

He was in the group as a permanent member at that time. I’m trying to recall who was it that left first, was it Joe or myself. But we left within a couple of months of each other. Either he or I was first. I think maybe it was myself. And I left in ‘61. I think he was still there then. But the last week that I worked with the band, we worked with Tony Bennett at the place in Jersey, what’s the name of it, Lantasina or Latin Quarter or something like that. So I don’t think Joe was singing that week, because…
